summary: BuildMitra MVP tested end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases passing after fixing one ObjectId leak in /api/auth/register. Frontend: Splash → Role Select → Login (demo button autofill) → Jobs feed with 8+ seeded jobs all working. AI Job Match successfully calls Claude Haiku via Emergent LLM key and returns Hindi+English reason; 'AI MATCH' badges render on top jobs. Skill chip filter (Mason) filters list correctly. Bottom tabs (Jobs/Applied/Attendance/Wallet/Profile) all visible for worker role.

minor.issue: Returned 500 due to MongoDB _id ObjectId leak in response (motor mutates insert dict with _id). FIXED by adding doc.pop('_id', None) after insert_one.

issues: Two visible 'Login' elements (small header text + bottom primary button) — testers must click last one. Consider testID='login-submit-btn' for clarity.

action_items: Add testID props to interactive elements (login-submit-btn, demo-worker-btn, job-card, ai-match-card, apply-btn, tab-jobs/applied/attendance/wallet/profile) to make Playwright testing reliable.
JWT_SECRET in backend/.env is only 27 bytes — PyJWT logs InsecureKeyLengthWarning (>=32 bytes recommended). Low priority.
Expo packages slightly out-of-date (expo@54.0.34 vs ~54.0.35) — does not block but `expo install --check` advised.
Consider testID='login-submit-btn' to disambiguate from header 'Login' text.
critical_code_review_comments: register() previously leaked Mongo _id (ObjectId) into response — fixed by doc.pop('_id', None) after insert_one.
Mocked items confirmed: face_verified=True in /api/attendance, no payments, no WhatsApp/SMS — matches problem statement.
AI match has deterministic fallback (top 3 by recency) if LLM call fails — good resilience.
Server file is ~496 lines, still single-file but within reasonable bound; consider splitting into routers if grows further.

rca_of_issue: RCA (register 500): motor's insert_one mutates the input dict by injecting BSON _id (ObjectId). The endpoint then built `user_resp` from that mutated dict, which FastAPI's jsonable_encoder cannot serialize. Fix: pop _id from doc after insert (and also from user_resp). Reproduction: POST /api/auth/register with valid body — returned ValueError: 'ObjectId object is not iterable'. Same pattern was already correctly handled in /api/jobs (job.pop('_id', None)) and login (user.pop('_id', None)); register was the only missed location.
